display.purpose: The auth screen's single statement, and the study timer. 2.5rem on phones.

headline.purpose: The one sentence that names the gap, and the quiz result. 1.75rem on phones.

title.purpose: Page titles and the large figures in stat blocks.

action.purpose: Button text. 0.875rem on small buttons and segmented controls.

label.purpose: Stat labels, table headers, hints and metadata.

motion.name: ink-in
motion.purpose: The bubble fill: a clip-path wipe from circle(0% at 30% 40%) to circle(100% at 50% 50%).

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Colour transitions on buttons, nav items, segmented items and quiz options.

motion.name: skeleton-pulse
motion.purpose: Opacity pulse to 0.45 on pale blue skeletons.

components.name: Ink Button
components.description: The primary action, such as the next task's Start. Black because acting is the user's own mark.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-sheet); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, color 150ms; background: var(--color-ink); color: #fff; border: none; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { background: #2c2c36; } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ink:disabled { background: #8d8a92; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Print Button
components.description: The secondary action, printed in blue with a 1px outline.
components.css: .ds-btn-print { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-sheet); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, color 150ms; background: var(--color-sheet); color: var(--color-print-dark); border: 1px solid var(--color-print); } .ds-btn-print:hover { background: var(--color-tint); } .ds-btn-print:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-print:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-sheet); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, color 150ms; background: transparent; color: var(--color-print-dark); border: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-tint); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions. Neutral at rest, and red only on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-sheet); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, color 150ms; background: var(--color-sheet); color: var(--color-ink); border: 1px solid var(--color-ink-soft); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #fbe4e4; border-color: #a01818; color: #8e1414; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above, hint below, a warm grey outline that turns blue on hover and black on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: var(--font-sans); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-field-hint { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-ink-soft); margin-top: 4px; } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #7c8fa3; border-radius: var(--radius-sheet); background: var(--color-sheet); color: inherit; font: inherit; caret-color: var(--color-print); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--color-print); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-ink); outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A blue-outlined choice of two or three. The selected item is black because it is the user's mark.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--color-print); border-radius: var(--radius-sheet); overflow: hidden; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-seg-item { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; background: var(--color-sheet); color: var(--color-print-dark); transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-seg-item:hover { background: var(--color-tint); } .ds-seg-item[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--color-ink); color: #fff; } .ds-seg-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: The desktop rail. Blue, with a hollow circle per item and a filled black one on the active item.
components.html: DashboardToday's PlanQuiz
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 240px; padding: 16px; background: var(--color-print); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-rail-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-sheet); color: #fff; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: var(--color-print-dark); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-rail-mark { flex: none; width: 16px; height: 16px; border: 1.5px solid #fff; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-rail-item[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--color-sheet); color: var(--color-print-dark); font-weight: 600; } .ds-rail-item[aria-current='page'] .ds-rail-mark { background: var(--color-ink); border-color: var(--color-ink); }

components.name: Open Panel
components.description: A section: a 1.5px blue rule and a blue title, with no box. The tinted variant is for closing prompts.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-panels { display: grid; gap: 32px; font-family: var(--font-sans); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-panels p { margin: 0; } .ds-panel { border-top: 1.5px solid var(--color-print); padding-top: 12px; } .ds-panel-tint { background: var(--color-tint); border-radius: var(--radius-sheet); padding: 16px; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.375; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-print-dark); }

components.name: Bubble and 30-Day Record
components.description: The signature mark: empty, filled with a quick ink stroke, lettered, and as a proportional daily record.
components.html: AB
components.css: @keyframes ds-ink-in { from { clip-path: circle(0% at 30% 40%); } to { clip-path: circle(100% at 50% 50%); } } .ds-bubbles { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-bubble { position: relative; display: inline-flex; flex: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-print); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--color-print); background: var(--color-sheet); } .ds-bubble[data-filled='true'] { border-color: var(--color-ink); color: #fff; } .ds-bubble-ink { position: absolute; inset: -1.5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-ink); animation: ds-ink-in 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-bubble-label { position: relative; } .ds-day { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-print); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-day[data-full='true'] { border-color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-day-ink { display: block; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-ink); }

components.css: .ds-tasks { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-task { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 0; color: var(--color-print-dark); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line); } .ds-task:first-child { border-top: none; } .ds-task[data-done='true'] { color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-task-bubble { flex: none; width: 26px; height: 26px; margin-top: 2px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-print); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-sheet); } .ds-task[data-done='true'] .ds-task-bubble { background: var(--color-ink); border-color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-task-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-task-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0 12px; } .ds-task-head h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-task-head span { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-task-body p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-task-start { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-sheet); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, color 150ms; margin-top: 8px; background: var(--color-ink); color: #fff; border: none; } .ds-task-start:hover { background: #2c2c36; } .ds-task-start:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
An OMR scanner ignores the coloured print and reads only black marks. PrepSaathi works the same way: the plan is printed in blue, and only what the aspirant actually did is black. Every screen is a white sheet with a question printed on it and a record being filled in, so the uncomfortable number (hours planned against hours done) is visible before anything else.

Density is that of a working form: open sections under a blue rule, rows divided by hairlines, one family of type, one mark. Nothing floats and nothing glows. The sheet is familiar to the people using it, because they fill sheets like this in exam halls, and it stays legible on a mid-range Android phone on a slow connection in both English and Hindi.

The system refuses the category's stat-card dashboard with soft shadows and an indigo accent. There is no dark mode in this version: the sheet is white, and a night theme is deferred.
keyCharacteristics: Blue print is the plan and the structure; black ink is what the user did.
One signature mark, the bubble, carries task state, quiz answers, navigation state and the 30-day record.
One family, Hind, self-hosted, for Latin and Devanagari alike.
White sheet ground, no shadows, 4px corners, open sections under a 1.5px blue rule rather than closed cards.
Lite mode removes charts, proof images and animation, and the screens still work.

rules.name: The Drop-Out Rule
rules.body: Print is the plan and the structure; ink is what the user actually did. If a mark or a figure records something the user did, it is black. If it states what the sheet asks for, it is blue. Reading text and primary actions are the only other uses of black.

rules.name: The Meaning Only Rule
rules.body: Warn, good and error colours appear only on a state that is true right now. They are never decoration, section colour or category colour, and every notice also carries an icon so status never rests on colour alone.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Hind is the only family, for both scripts. Hierarchy comes from size and weight, never from a second face. Numerals in tables are tabular.

rules.name: The Plain Label Rule
rules.body: A heading stands on its own. No eyebrow or small label is stacked above it, no text is set in tracked capitals, and no text is filled with a gradient.

rules.name: The Next Action First Rule
rules.body: On phones the sentence comes first, then today's tasks, then the chart. Reorder the columns rather than shrinking them so the next thing to do is thumb-reachable.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow, at rest or on hover. Paper does not lift. State changes are colour changes.

rules.name: The Open Section Rule
rules.body: A section is a 1.5px blue rule across the top with a blue title beneath it, and no box. A closed shape is reserved for the pale blue tinted panel and for things the user must act inside, such as dialogs and quiz options.

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: If something can be marked, it is marked with a bubble. Checkboxes, toggles and radio buttons take this form over a visually hidden native input. Do not introduce a second completion mark.

rules.name: The Dashed Plan Rule
rules.body: Planned is dashed blue and done is solid black, in every chart and every legend. The dataviz validator flags black as too low in lightness and chroma for a categorical slot. This is accepted on purpose, because it is the brand rule. Colour-vision and contrast checks pass, and dashed against solid is the secondary encoding.

rules.name: The Lite Truth Rule
rules.body: Lite mode must keep the low-bandwidth claim true. Any new heavy surface needs a Lite version that shows the same numbers as text.

dos: Do draw every plan, label and structural rule in blue, and every user mark and user figure in black, per the Drop-Out Rule.
Do use #174f8f, not #1d63b0, for small printed text.
Do start a section with a 1.5px blue rule and a blue title, with no box around it.
Do use the bubble for anything the user marks, over a real, visually hidden input.
Do keep one black primary action per task list: the next task's Start button.
Do pair every chart with its table and every coloured status with an icon or text.
Do teach the next action in empty states, and show only measured or clearly labelled sample numbers.
Do check every new screen in Hindi and in Lite mode.
donts: Don't use the word "verification" for proofs. A proof is an honesty nudge, and the copy says "proof", "counted" or "check-in".
Don't place an eyebrow or small label above a heading.
Don't add shadows, at rest or on hover.
Don't build the category's stat-card dashboard: closed cards, soft shadows and an indigo accent.
Don't draw a planned or printed value in black, or a completed mark in blue.
Don't use warn, good or error colours for anything other than their state.
Don't add a second typeface, or load Hind from a font service.
Don't add dark mode styling yet. A night theme is deferred.
